20/S0.subgoal: Explain the role of physics support, including mechanics, collision, and environment simulation, in a virtual world generator.

20/S1.subgoal: Explain how network experience and collaborative VR functionality work within a virtual world generator.

20/S2.subgoal: Compare the trade-offs between building a virtual world generator from scratch using SDKs versus using a ready-made engine.

20/S3.subgoal: Describe how game engines serve as middleware for XR development and identify their core components.

20/S4.subgoal: Describe the different types of deployment for VR applications, including native and web-based options.
